source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 8 (PDF 180-204), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Plant Physiology) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 A substance that provides the body with essential ingredients required for metabolism is called a:
(Woh substance jo jism ko metabolism ke liye zaroori ajza deta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nutrient (ghizai juz) jism ko metabolism ke liye zaroori ajza deta hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: A nutrient is a substance that provides the body with essential ingredients required for metabolism

blocks.prompt:
2 Which group of nutrients serves as sources of energy?
(Nutrients ka kaun sa group energy ka zariya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates, lipids aur proteins energy dete hain; water, electrolytes, minerals aur vitamins metabolic process ke liye zaroori hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Specific nutrients, such as carbohydrates, lipids, and proteins, serve as sources of energy

blocks.prompt:
3 The collective processes involved in the intake and utilization of nutrients for growth, repair and maintenance are called:
(Growth, repair aur maintenance ke liye nutrients lene aur istemal karne ke majmui amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nutrition (ghiza) nutrients lene aur istemal karne ke majmui amal ka naam hai, growth, repair aur maintenance ke liye (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Nutrition refers to the collective processes involved in the intake and utilization of nutrients

blocks.prompt:
4 How many macronutrients are there for plants?
(Plants ke liye kitne macronutrients hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nau (9) macronutrients hain: C, H, O, N, K, Ca, P, Mg aur S (8.1).

book_ref.quote: There are nine macronutrients

blocks.prompt:
5 How many micronutrients are named for plants?
(Plants ke liye kitne micronutrients bataye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saat (7) micronutrients hain: iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum, copper, chlorine aur boron (8.1).

book_ref.quote: There are seven micronutrients

blocks.prompt:
6 Which one of the following is a micronutrient?
(In mein se kaun sa micronutrient hai?)
blocks.explanation: Boron saat micronutrients mein se hai; potassium, calcium aur sulphur macronutrients hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum, copper, chlorine, and boron

blocks.prompt:
7 Which element constitutes the core of the chlorophyll molecule?
(Kaun sa element chlorophyll molecule ka markaz (core) banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium chlorophyll molecule ka core hai, is liye photosynthesis ke liye zaroori hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Magnesium constitutes the core of the chlorophyll molecule

blocks.prompt:
8 Which macronutrient is a part of ATP and promotes root growth?
(Kaun sa macronutrient ATP ka hissa hai aur jaron ki growth barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus ATP ka hissa hai; yeh root growth barhata hai aur phool aane mein madad karta hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Phosphorus is a part of ATP

blocks.prompt:
9 A deficiency of nitrogen in plants results in:
(Plants mein nitrogen ki kami ka nateeja kya hai?)

options.text: patton ka girna aur ruki hui growth
patton ka waqt se pehle girna aur der se pakna

blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ki kami se patte girte hain aur growth ruk jati hai (stunted growth) (8.1).

book_ref.quote: A deficiency of nitrogen results in leaf loss and stunted growth

blocks.prompt:
10 Dark patches are formed on the leaves when there is a shortage of:
(Patton par gehre dhabbe kis ki kami se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Potassium ki kami se patton par gehre dhabbe bante hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Dark patches are formed on the leaves when there is shortage of potassium

blocks.prompt:
11 Which element provides stability to the cell wall and aids in the development of seeds?
(Kaun sa element cell wall ko mazbooti deta hai aur beejon ki development mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Calcium cell wall ko mazboot karta hai aur beej banne mein madad deta hai; is ki kami se peele aur bhoore dhabbe aate hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Calcium provides stability to the cell wall and promotes the development of the cell wall

blocks.prompt:
12 Which element is fundamental in the metabolism of nitrogen, and its shortage makes the plant lighter in colour?
(Kaun sa element nitrogen ke metabolism mein bunyadi hai aur is ki kami se plant ka rang halka ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfur nitrogen metabolism ka bunyadi element hai; is ki kami se plant ka rang halka ho jata hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: If there is a shortage of sulfur, the plant becomes lighter in colour

blocks.prompt:
13 Interveinal chlorosis results from the deficiency of:
(Interveinal chlorosis kis ki kami se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iron chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori hai; is ki kami se interveinal chlorosis (rago ke darmiyan peela pan) hoti hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Its deficiency results in interveinal chlorosis

blocks.prompt:
14 Premature falling of the leaf and delayed maturity are caused by the deficiency of:
(Patte ka waqt se pehle girna aur der se pakna kis ki kami se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manganese ki kami se patta waqt se pehle girta hai aur plant der se pakta hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Its deficiency results in the premature falling of the leaf and delayed maturity

blocks.prompt:
15 Manganese is important for the activity of which antioxidant enzyme?
(Manganese kis antioxidant enzyme ki activity ke liye ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manganese antioxidant enzymes jaise superoxide dismutase ke liye ahem hai jo oxidative stress kam karte hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: such as superoxide dismutase (SOD)

blocks.prompt:
16 Which micronutrient facilitates chlorophyll synthesis, root development and uptake of nutrients?
(Kaun sa micronutrient chlorophyll banane, jaron ki development aur nutrients lene mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zinc chlorophyll, jaron ki development aur nutrients lene mein madad karta hai; is ki kami se growth ruk sakti hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Zinc facilitates chlorophyll synthesis, root development and uptake of nutrients

blocks.prompt:
17 Which micronutrient is critical for nitrogen fixation and nitrogen reduction?
(Kaun sa micronutrient nitrogen fixation aur nitrogen reduction ke liye nihayat zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molybdenum nitrogen fixation, nitrogen reduction, sulfur aur phosphorus metabolism aur iron ke istemal ke liye zaroori hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Molybdenum is critical for nitrogen fixation

blocks.prompt:
18 Which element is necessary for lignin synthesis, giving strength and rigidity to the cell wall?
(Kaun sa element lignin banane ke liye zaroori hai jo cell wall ko mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Copper lignin banane ke liye zaroori hai jo cell wall ko mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Copper is necessary for lignin synthesis

blocks.prompt:
19 Which micronutrient is involved in stomatal regulation and osmotic adjustment?
(Kaun sa micronutrient stomata ke control aur osmotic adjustment mein shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorine stomata ke control, osmotic adjustment aur nutrients ki transport mein shamil hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Chlorine is involved in stomatal regulation, osmotic adjustment and transport of nutrients

blocks.prompt:
20 Insectivorous plants are:
(Insectivorous (keeray khane wale) plants kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam insectivorous plants asal autotrophs (apni ghiza khud banane wale) hain; shikar pakarne par in ki growth tez hoti hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: All insectivorous plants are true autotrophs

blocks.prompt:
21 Insectivorous plants mainly benefit from which compounds of the animal body?
(Insectivorous plants jaanwar ke jism ke kin compounds se faida uthate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zahiri tor par jaanwar ke jism ke nitrogenous compounds in plants ko faida dete hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Apparently, nitrogenous compounds of animal body are of benefit to these plants

blocks.prompt:
22 In the pitcher plant, the pitcher is a modified:
(Pitcher plant mein pitcher (ghara) kis cheez ki badli hui shakal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pitcher plant ke patte thaili ya ghare mein badal jate hain jis mein kuch paani hota hai; patte ka aakhri hissa dhakkan (hood) banata hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Pitcher plant has leaves modified into a sac or a pitcher

blocks.prompt:
23 In the pitcher plant, insects are prevented from crawling out of the pitcher by:
(Pitcher plant mein keeron ko bahar rengne se kya rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pitcher mein bohat se sakht baal hote hain jo andar gire keeron ko bahar nikalne nahi dete (8.1).

book_ref.quote: It has numerous stiff hairs that prevent little insects from crawling out

blocks.prompt:
24 In Venus-fly trap, the lobes close rapidly when prey touches:
(Venus-fly trap mein shikar ke chhoone par lobes kis wajah se tezi se band hote hain?)

options.text: lobes ki andar ki satah ke trichomes
patte ki nok par dew ka qatra

blocks.explanation: Lobes ki andar ki satah par trichomes (baal jaise ubhaar) shikar ke chhoone par lobes ko tezi se band kar dete hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: which are hair-like projections that trigger the lobes to close rapidly upon contact with prey

blocks.prompt:
25 In Venus-fly trap, the prey is prevented from escaping because:
(Venus-fly trap mein shikar kyun bhaag nahi sakta?)

options.text: band hone par trap ke bareek bristles aapas mein phans jate hain
pitcher ke sakht baal neeche ki taraf hote hain
tentacles use dew mein uljha dete hain

blocks.explanation: Trap ke kinaron par bareek bristles band hone par aapas mein phans jate hain, is liye shikar nahi bhaag sakta (8.1).

book_ref.quote: The hinged traps are lined with fine bristles that interlock upon closure

blocks.prompt:
26 Which insectivorous plant catches its prey with shiny drops of "dew" on tentacle-like hairs?
(Kaun sa insectivorous plant tentacle jaise baalon par chamakdar "dew" ke qatron se shikar pakarta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sundew chamakdar dew ke qatron se shikar pakarta hai; boo se aaye keeray tentacles mein phans jate hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Sundew catches its prey with shiny drops of

blocks.prompt:
27 Stomata are typically found in:
(Stomata aam tor par kahan paye jate hain?)

options.text: patton mein, aur kuch tanon mein bhi

blocks.explanation: Stomata aam tor par patton mein hote hain magar kuch tanon mein bhi ho sakte hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: These are typically found in leaves but can even be present in some stems

blocks.prompt:
28 Guard cells of stomata are:
(Stomata ke guard cells kaise hote hain?)

options.text: bean ki shakal ke magar chloroplasts ke baghair
bean ki shakal ke aur chloroplasts wale
sitare ki shakal ke aur chloroplasts wale

blocks.explanation: Guard cells lobia (bean) ki shakal ke hote hain aur un mein chloroplasts hote hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Guard cells are bean-shaped and contain chloroplasts

blocks.prompt:
29 The opening and closing of stomata control the rate of:
(Stomata ka khulna aur band hona kis ki raftaar ko control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stomata ka khulna aur band hona plants mein transpiration (bukharat) ki raftaar control karta hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: The opening and closing of stomata control the transpiration rate in plants

blocks.prompt:
30 Stomata typically close at night in order to:
(Raat ko stomata aam tor par kyun band hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Raat ko photosynthesis ruk jati hai, is liye stomata paani bachane ke liye band hote hain; respiration phir bhi jari rehti hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: At night, when photosynthesis ceases due to lack of light, stomata typically close to conserve water

blocks.prompt:
31 Guard cells function as:
(Guard cells kis tarah kaam karte hain?)

options.text: aik taraf chalne wale mechanical pumps
sirf starch jama karne wale cells

blocks.explanation: Guard cells multisensory hydraulic valves (kayi ishaaron par chalne wale paani ke valve) ki tarah kaam karte hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: The guard cells function as multisensory hydraulic valves

blocks.prompt:
32 The starch sugar hypothesis of stomatal movement was proposed in 1856 by:
(Stomata ki harkat ka starch sugar hypothesis 1856 mein kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1856 mein German botanist H. Van Mohl ne starch sugar hypothesis pesh kiya (8.2).

book_ref.quote: In 1856, German botanist H. Van Mohl proposed

blocks.prompt:
33 According to the starch sugar hypothesis, stomata close at night because:
(Starch sugar hypothesis ke mutabiq raat ko stomata kyun band hote hain?)

options.text: K⁺ active tor par guard cells mein jata hai
sugar starch ban jati hai ya respire hoti hai, is liye paani guard cells se nikal jata hai
blue light guard cells ko acidic karti hai
abscisic acid K⁺ ko guard cells mein dalta hai

blocks.explanation: Raat ko sugar na-hal-pazeer starch ban jati hai ya respiration mein lag jati hai; free sugar kam hone se paani bahar nikalta hai aur guard cells dheele (flaccid) ho jate hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: At night, photosynthesis ceases, and sugars are converted to insoluble starch or used for respiration

blocks.prompt:
34 The weakness of the starch sugar hypothesis is that it does not fully explain:
(Starch sugar hypothesis ki kamzori kya hai, yeh kis cheez ki poori wazahat nahi karta?)

options.text: guard cells mein chloroplasts ki maujoodgi
raat ko stomata ka band hona
stomata se CO₂ ka andar aana
guard cells mein turgor ki tez tabdeeli

blocks.explanation: Yeh mechanism stomata ki harkat ke dauran guard cells mein turgor ki tez tabdeeli ki poori wazahat nahi karta (8.2).

book_ref.quote: However, this mechanism does not fully explain the rapid turgor changes in guard cells during stomatal movements

blocks.prompt:
35 According to the second hypothesis, stomata open because of the active transport of which ion into guard cells?
(Doosre hypothesis ke mutabiq kis ion ki guard cells mein active transport se stomata khulte hain?)
blocks.explanation: K⁺ ki guard cells mein active transport un ka osmotic potential kam karti hai; paani osmosis se andar aata hai aur stomata khulte hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: which reduces their osmotic potential

blocks.prompt:
36 Which light enhances K⁺ uptake by guard cells?
(Kaun si roshni guard cells mein K⁺ ke dakhle ko barhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blue light aas paas ke mahol ko acidic kar ke K⁺ aur paani ke dakhle ko barhati hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Blue light enhances this process by acidifying the surrounding environment

blocks.prompt:
37 At night, K⁺ leaves the guard cells by:
(Raat ko K⁺ guard cells se kis tarah nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Raat ko K⁺ passive diffusion se bahar nikalta hai; paani nikalne se guard cells flaccid ho jate hain aur stomata band (8.2).

book_ref.quote: At night, K⁺ passively diffuses out of the guard cells

blocks.prompt:
38 At high temperature, when leaf cells start wilting, the hormone released by mesophyll cells to close stomata is:
(Zyada temperature par jab patte ke cells murjhane lagen to mesophyll cells kaun sa hormone chhorte hain jo stomata band karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Abscisic acid guard cells mein K⁺ ki active transport rok deta hai, roshni aur CO₂ ke asar ko bhi, aur stomata band ho jate hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: a hormone called abscisic acid, is released by mesophyll cells

blocks.prompt:
39 Palisade tissue of the leaf is located:
(Patte ka palisade tissue kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Palisade tissue upper epidermis ke bilkul neeche hota hai; is ke lambe, ghane cells chloroplasts se bhare hote hain (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Palisade tissue is primarily located just beneath the upper epidermis of the leaf

blocks.prompt:
40 After entering the leaf through stomata, CO₂ first travels through the air spaces of the:
(Stomata se patte mein dakhil hone ke baad CO₂ pehle kis ki hawai jagahon se guzarti hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ stomata se andar aa kar spongy mesophyll ki hawai jagahon se guzarti hai, phir palisade cells mein photosynthesis ke liye jati hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Once inside, the gas travels through air spaces within the spongy mesophyll

blocks.prompt:
41 The internal hydrostatic pressure that maintains the rigidity of parenchyma cells is called:
(Andar ka hydrostatic dabao jo parenchyma cells ki sakhti qaim rakhta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parenchyma cells ka jazb kiya paani andar dabao banata hai jise turgor pressure kehte hain; yeh cells ko sakht rakhta hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: This water creates an internal hydrostatic pressure known as turgor pressure

blocks.prompt:
42 The membrane that surrounds the vacuole is called:
(Vacuole ko gherne wali membrane ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tonoplast vacuole ko gherti hai; is ki active transport ions ko vacuole mein le jati hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: The membrane that surrounds the vacuole is called the tonoplast

blocks.prompt:
43 Which supporting cells lack secondary walls and have primary walls thickened at the corners?
(Kaun se sahara dene wale cells mein secondary wall nahi hoti aur primary wall konon par moti hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Collenchyma cells mein secondary wall nahi hoti; un ki primary wall konon par moti hoti hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: Collenchyma cells lack secondary walls

blocks.prompt:
44 The corners of collenchyma walls are thickened due to extra deposition of:
(Collenchyma ki walls ke kone kis cheez ke izafi jamao se mote hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Collenchyma ki primary walls konon par cellulose ke izafi jamao se moti hoti hain (8.3).

book_ref.quote: Their primary walls are thickened at the corners, due to extra deposition of cellulose

blocks.prompt:
45 Collenchyma is found:
(Collenchyma kahan paya jata hai?)

options.text: beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol mein
purane lakri wale tane ke pith mein
jawan tanon aur patte ki dandi ki epidermis ke neeche

blocks.explanation: Collenchyma jawan tanon aur patte ki dandi ki epidermis ke neeche aur rago ke saath hota hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: They are found beneath the epidermis of young stems, leaf stalks and along veins in leaves

blocks.prompt:
46 The thick secondary walls of sclerenchyma are saturated with:
(Sclerenchyma ki moti secondary walls kis se bhari hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sclerenchyma ki walls lignin se bhari hoti hain jo mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: These walls are saturated with lignin

blocks.prompt:
47 The majority of sclerenchyma cells are:
(Sclerenchyma ke zyada tar cells kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sclerenchyma ke zyada tar cells murda (non-living) hote hain; is ka asal kaam sahara dena hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: The majority of sclerenchyma cells are non-living

blocks.prompt:
48 Sclereids are present in:
(Sclereids kahan paye jate hain?)

options.text: jawan tanon ki epidermis ke neeche
beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol

blocks.explanation: Sclereids fibres se chhote hote hain aur beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol mein hote hain; in ka kaam hifazat hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: are present in the seed coats and shells of nuts

blocks.prompt:
49 Water potential is symbolized by the Greek letter:
(Water potential ko kis Greek harf se zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Water potential ko Greek harf psi, Ψw se likhte hain (8.4).

book_ref.quote: symbolized by Greek letter psi

blocks.prompt:
50 The water potential of pure water is, by definition:
(Definition ke mutabiq khalis paani ka water potential kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khalis paani ka water potential sab se zyada hai jo definition se zero hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: Pure water has maximum water potential which by definition is zero

blocks.prompt:
51 At atmospheric pressure, the water potential of any solution is:
(Atmospheric pressure par kisi bhi solution ka water potential kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: higher than that of pure water

blocks.explanation: Har solution ka Ψw khalis paani se kam hai, is liye negative hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: All solutions have lower Ψw than pure water

blocks.prompt:
52 In terms of water potential, osmosis is the movement of water through a partially permeable membrane from:
(Water potential ke hawale se osmosis mein paani partially permeable membrane se kahan se kahan jata hai?)

options.text: kam Ψw se zyada Ψw ki taraf
zyada Ψw se kam Ψw ki taraf
kam pressure potential se zero ki taraf
solution se khalis paani ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Osmosis mein paani zyada water potential se kam water potential ki taraf partially permeable membrane se jata hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: So, the osmosis can be defined as the movement of water molecules from a region of higher water potential

blocks.prompt:
53 If more solute molecules are present, the solute potential becomes:
(Agar zyada solute molecules hon to solute potential kaisa ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ψs hamesha negative hai; zyada solute se Ψs aur kam (zyada negative) hota hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: Ψs is always a negative value

blocks.prompt:
54 If pressure greater than atmospheric pressure is applied to a solution, its water potential:
(Agar solution par atmospheric pressure se zyada dabao dala jaye to us ka water potential:)
blocks.explanation: Atmospheric se zyada dabao water potential barhata hai; yeh hissa pressure potential hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: If pressure greater than atmospheric pressure is applied to pure water or a solution, its water potential increases

blocks.prompt:
55 The total water potential of a plant cell is given by:
(Plant cell ka kul water potential kis tarah milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul water potential solute potential aur pressure potential ka majmua hai: Ψw = Ψs + Ψp (8.4).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the total water potential (Ψw) is sum of solute potential

blocks.prompt:
56 The flow of water along a water potential gradient is faster when the gradient is:
(Water potential gradient par paani ka bahao kab tez hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gradient jitna zyada dhalwan (steep) ho, paani utna tez behta hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: The steeper the potential gradient the faster is the flow of water along it

blocks.prompt:
57 Root hairs are extensions of the root's:
(Root hairs jar ke kin cells ki lambi shakal hain?)
blocks.explanation: Root hairs jar ke epidermal cells ke barhe hue hisse hain; zyada tar paani aur minerals inhi se jazb hote hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: which are actually extensions of epidermal cells of roots

blocks.prompt:
58 The apoplast pathway becomes discontinuous in the endodermis due to:
(Endodermis mein apoplast pathway kis wajah se toot jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Endodermis mein Casparian segments ki wajah se apoplast pathway toot jata hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: The apoplast pathway becomes discontinuous in the endodermis

blocks.prompt:
59 The pathway of water through the system of adjacent cell walls of root cells is the:
(Jar ke cells ki saath saath walls ke nizaam se paani ka rasta kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Apoplast pathway jar mein saath saath cell walls ka musalsal rasta hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: It is a continuous pathway that involves a system of adjacent cell walls in the plant roots

blocks.prompt:
60 Plasmodesmata are:
(Plasmodesmata kya hain?)

options.text: saath wali cell walls ke surakhon se guzarti cytoplasm ki dhaariyan

blocks.explanation: Plasmodesmata cytoplasm ki dhaariyan hain jo saath wali cell walls ke surakhon se guzarti hain; yeh symplast pathway mein protoplasts ko jorti hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: which are cytoplasmic strands that extend through pores in adjacent cell walls

blocks.prompt:
61 Movement of water through which pathway in roots is negligible?
(Jar mein kis raste se paani ki harkat na hone ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vacuolar pathway mein paani aik vacuole se doosre mein jata hai; yeh harkat na hone ke barabar hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Movement in vacuolar pathway is negligible

blocks.prompt:
62 Which one of the following is NOT a component of xylem?
(In mein se kaun sa xylem ka hissa NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Xylem mein tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma hote hain; companion cells phloem ke hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Xylem comprises of tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres and xylem parenchyma

blocks.prompt:
63 Tracheids are linked to each other by:
(Tracheids aapas mein kis cheez se jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tracheids ke sire patle hote hain aur yeh bordered pits se jure hote hain jo paani ko pehlu ki taraf jane dete hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: they are linked to each other by bordered pits

blocks.prompt:
64 Compared to tracheids, vessels are:
(Tracheids ke muqable mein vessels kaise hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vessels tracheids se chhote aur chaure hote hain aur musalsal naliyan banate hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Vessels are shorter and broader compared to tracheids

blocks.prompt:
65 The living, thin-walled component of xylem that takes part in lateral translocation is:
(Xylem ka zinda, patli wall wala hissa jo pehlu ki taraf transport mein hissa leta hai, kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Xylem parenchyma zinda patli wall wale cells hain jo nutrients aur paani rakhte hain aur pehlu ki taraf transport karte hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Xylem parenchyma are living cells with thin walls

blocks.prompt:
66 In the TACT mechanism, the letter 'A' stands for:
(TACT mechanism mein harf 'A' kis ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: TACT ka matlab Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion aur Tension hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: The TACT (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) mechanism

blocks.prompt:
67 The primary driving force behind water transport in the xylem is:
(Xylem mein paani ki transport ki asal chalane wali quwwat kya hai?)
